title: Without Inventory Delete there is no Activate parts, and View only gets 403 from the API
custom_preconds: Custom role 1: Part Library & Inventory View + Create & Edit, Delete off. Custom role 2: View only. One inactive part A.
custom_steps:
1. Log in with role 1 → Inventory → Inactive tab → ⋮
  2. Log in with role 2 → Inactive tab → ⋮
  3. As role 2 replay PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":["<A>"],"status":"active"}
custom_expected:
1. No "Activate parts" item
  2. No "Activate parts" item
  3. 403 "Access denied."; A stays inactive
